title: Minimum Description Length based Granular-Ball Tree Regularization for Spectral Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2605.22410v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes Minimum Description Length based Granular-Ball Tree Regularized Spectral Clustering (MDL-GBTRSC), a fixed-K method that uses granular balls as regional descriptors for sample-level affinity construction rather than as reduced graph nodes. A reciprocal-neighborhood continuity term is incorporated into an MDL-based refinement criterion to construct a granular-ball hierarchy, and the structural scales of the terminal regions are transferred to the original sample graph before spectral partitioning. Experiments on 18 real and 20 synthetic datasets, comprising 109,969 samples in total, compare MDL-GBTRSC with nine competing methods. On the 17 real datasets completed by all methods, MDL-GBTRSC achieves mean ARI and NMI values of 0.5998 and 0.6613, compared with the next-highest means of 0.5792 and 0.6285, respectively. translated_title: 基于最小描述长度的粒球树正则化谱聚类
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种基于最小描述长度的粒球树正则化谱聚类方法（MDL-GBTRSC），这是一种固定聚类数K的方法，它将粒球用作区域描述符来构建样本级相似度矩阵，而不是将其作为简化图的节点。该方法在基于最小描述长度（MDL）的细化准则中引入了互近邻连续性项，以构建粒球层次结构，并在谱划分之前将终端区域的结构尺度传递到原始样本图上。在总共包含109,969个样本的18个真实数据集和20个合成数据集上的实验中，MDL-GBTRSC与九种竞争方法进行了比较。在所有方法均完成运行的17个真实数据集上，MDL-GBTRSC的平均ARI和NMI值分别为0.5998和0.6613，而次高方法的平均值分别为0.5792和0.6285。在20个合成数据集上，它取得的平均ARI和NMI值分别为0.9618和0.9688，相比……
tldr: 本文提出MDL-GBTRSC方法，通过将基于最小描述长度的粒球树正则化引入谱聚类，利用粒球作为区域描述符构建样本级相似度并传递终端区域结构尺度，在真实与合成数据集上的聚类性能均优于九种对比方法。
